Rules + behavioral signals run first and stay the source of truth for auto-removal\n   (invite link, wallet, finance+link, established-member gate). Clear spam is removed, clear\n   chatter allowed — before any LLM call.\n2. Only messages the rules land on `review` (the ambiguous middle) are sent to the LLM. This bounds\n   volume to a handful/day, so cost/latency stay negligible.\n3. LLM input = message body + light context (sender established? has link? new member?). Output =\n   strict JSON `{verdict: spam|unsure|ham, confidence, reason}`.\n4. **Phase 1 the LLM may only escalate to `review` or downgrade to allow — never auto-kick alone.**\n   Once measured on real traffic, allow `LLM spam + a behavioral signal` to auto-remove.\n5. Provider is a config switch with a timeout that fails open to the rule verdict:\n   - **OpenRouter** (recommended): a cheap capable model (Gemini Flash / GPT-4o-mini / Haiku) —\n     pennies/month at this volume, strong Hebrew, best for the \"hard to guess\" cases.\n   - **Ollama local** (fallback): zero-cost/private; needs a 7–9B model (Qwen2.5, Gemma2) for usable\n     Hebrew — a 3B is too weak for the subtle cases this is meant to catch.\n6. Safety: message fed as data only (no instruction-following on user text); no auto-action on LLM\n   verdict alone in phase 1.\n\n**Validate before wiring live:** replay the logged ambiguous + known-spam messages through the\ncandidate model, measure catch-rate vs false-positives. Local validation via Ollama is allowed;\ncloud validation runs only with explicit approval.\n"}
